svg.title: Three kernels, three different things found
svg.desc: The cross picture, 8 by 8, holding 9s along the middle two rows and middle two columns and 0s elsewhere. Three kernels are applied to it. The vertical-edge kernel of 1, 0, minus 1 gives a feature map running from plus 27 down to minus 27. The horizontal-edge kernel of 1, 1, 1 over 0, 0, 0 over minus 1, minus 1, minus 1 also runs from plus 27 to minus 27, but on the other pair of edges. The averaging kernel of nine ninths runs from plus 8 down to 0 and finds no edges at all. One window is worked out: 1 times 9 plus 0 times 9 plus minus 1 times 0 is 9, and 9 plus 9 plus 9 is 27.
svg.text: Change the nine numbers, change what it finds
